17/S0.subgoal: Explain the basic tracking concepts, types of sensors, and the four stages of the tracking process.

17/S1.subgoal: Describe what IMU sensors are and how they are used in the tracking process.

17/S2.subgoal: Explain the calibration process for mapping raw sensor values to accurate values.

17/S3.subgoal: Describe the registration process for setting the initial alignment between the real and virtual worlds.

17/S4.subgoal: Describe how to compute the orientation of a sensor over time by integrating sensor samples.

17/S5.subgoal: Explain how to use multiple sensors to correct for drift errors in orientation estimation.

17/S6.subgoal: Summarize the four stages of the tracking process and preview future topics.
